# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Assessment
| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| oos_mean | 1.8815 | ✅ Strong |
| oos_min | 0.4315 | ⚠️ Weak fold |
| exposure | 47-84% | ✅ Acceptable |
| degenerate_folds | [] | ✅ None |

**Primary concern**: oos_min significantly below 1.0 indicates fold instability. Focus should be on improving worst-fold robustness.

## Next Commands (3 lines)
```
aub scan --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --target oos_min --mutations shrink_exposure,add_filter --n 50
aub crossval --run db08d79b484756ab --diagnose-weak-folds --threshold 0.8
aub submit --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --if-improves oos_min --keep-oos-mean-above 1.5
```

## Rationale
1. **scan**: Generate 50 mutations targeting oos_min improvement via exposure shrinkage and additional filtering
2. **crossval**: Diagnose which folds are underperforming and why (threshold 0.8 to catch marginal folds)
3. **submit**: Auto-promote any variant that improves oos_min while maintaining acceptable oos_mean (>1.5)
